name: Gyromast's Retrieval
summary: On Darkshore's coast, Gelkak Gyromast needs help restoring his mechanical first mate. His winding key shattered on the rocks, and wildlife and murlocs scavenged the three pieces. Recovering them is the first step toward setting his crew right.

sections.title: Castaway on Darkshore
sections.body: Gelkak Gyromast is a gnome pirate stranded on Darkshore, far from the South Seas. He says aggressive threshadons attacked and sank his vessel just off the coast. The wreck cast him ashore among the flotsam, marooned and separated from his crew.

sections.title: The Scavenged Key
sections.body: Gelkak's first concern is his first mate, not provisions or gold. The companion needs a specialized key to operate, but the key shattered into three pieces when Gelkak crashed on the rocky shoals. Before he could gather them, reef crawlers on the beach, foreststriders near the woods, and scavengers from the Greymist murloc tribe carried the shiny pieces away.

sections.title: A Peculiar Companion
sections.body: Gelkak speaks of his first mate with a sea captain's fierce loyalty. He says the companion needs to be put in working order, and the broken key is vital to winding it up again.

faq.answer: Gelkak Gyromast is a gnome pirate whose vessel was attacked and sunk by predatory threshadons off Darkshore.

faq.q: What is the key used for?
aliases: why does gelkak need the key
faq.answer: The key is needed to reactivate and wind up Gelkak's mechanical first mate, which shut down during the shipwreck.

faq.q: Where did the three pieces of the key go?
faq.answer: The top piece went to foreststriders, the middle piece to Greymist murlocs, and the bottom piece to coastal reef crawlers after the key broke on shore.

faq.q: Why was a gnome pirate sailing near Darkshore?
faq.answer: Gelkak was sailing off northern Kalimdor in search of plunder when hostile threshadons ended his voyage.

faq.q: What happens after the key is reassembled?
faq.answer: With all three pieces of his key, Gelkak can wind up his companion and continue with Gyromast's Revenge.

faq.q: Who are the murlocs holding the key piece?
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs scavenged the middle piece. Their tribe lives among wreckage from drowned ships along Darkshore's shoals.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may recognize Gelkak's reliance on clockwork devices instead of flesh-and-blood shipmates, though his pirate life is unusual among your kin.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the challenge of keeping clockwork contraptions working after a violent shipwreck in saltwater.
